notes.title: 《V-LOVER！》Demo version store page now live！The goal is to nurture the most capable VTuber！
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694290/VTuberDemo/?beta=0
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/fd8203705f51126e39851503cd1947dda1d7d58d.gif

【Game Overview】
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif

You are a university freshman who loves watching VTuber live streams. You entered Big Mountain Production by chance and became a manager, meeting three unique VTubers and the actual person behind the character. Over the next year, lead them towards the path of realizing their dreams!
In addition to working hard to earn money and managing channels, you can also leverage your reliable charm as a manager to gradually enter the hearts of the three girls, even developing relationships with them that goes beyond "VTuber and manager"!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/3edb5781b92894cd05ad05d5f035aacddf4d8151.png

【Game Features】
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9b60f0b31d1f2cb93e71a9c9e7ae5b01035beb5f.png


 Exquisite fully animated H scenes
 25 H scenes
 More than 180 CGs including variants
 Interactive CG in dynamic
 Three-line parallel development system
 Full voice acting for the female lead
 Dress-up system
 Over 150,000 words of text


【Game System】
-Abundant Nurturing System-
Players need to arrange the weekly schedules for the three heroines according to their abilities and goals within a year in the game, while paying attention to their physical and mental health. If players fail to relieve their stress in time, irreversible and significant consequences will occur...
Special Date System: Fulfilling specific conditions before a designated date, such as the heroine's birthday, Christmas, or Tanabata, can trigger special storylines!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/f7d9a934dd485c698b74bfdf726209220534f0e4.png

-Ultra-realistic Live Streaming Scenes-
With Live2D model and realistic live streaming room settings, players can experience ultra-realistic live streaming.
VTubers will encounter various unexpected events during live streams, and players need to provide appropriate action suggestions based on the heroines' characteristics!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4ab425419e9ca14ab59ae2a5d0fe6e7fd85552d0.png

-Master of Time Management-
To synchronize the nurturing of three VTubers, you need to allocate action points wisely and choose which heroine's growth to witness.
Each training session is accompanied by a corresponding mini-game, and the VTubers can also grow rapidly when you perform well!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/799fbfed51f8c28ee8c65821215d307f2de2707f.png

notes.title: "Endless Tentacle Cave" now is release and 10% off!!!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/65150fc4fe30f17ebdf525ff21d5eb543e46d902.png

Game Plot
A young girl with the ability to control monsters inadvertently falls into a trap set by tentacles. Her ability fails, and her body is modified, rendering her completely defenseless. But the only thing on the minds of these monsters is "desire"! As long as I drain all the monsters I encounter, I can escape! And so, the girl's journey of escape begins.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/150c72ed942b7f7d75d79a2d4cc0e794a88576d1.jpg

Features
Demons, tentacle clothing, parasites, or even former allies!
There are about 50 types of enemies.
Over 40 animated battle sequences.
In addition to common CG, each type of enemy also has exclusive CG.
Total CG count: 120+ (no variations).
Includes a built-in 19-page story comic for preview anytime.
Embark on this fantastical journey driven solely by desire!

notes.title: "Single by Choice" Demo Version Released!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/f6a7db7504e4d9bdf3f8931c2a31865970858b72.png


You've inherited your family's super-strong pheromones, and now all the girls are after you... Too bad you want to stay a virgin! Now quick, run for your life or lose your chastity... forever!

Over ten sets of dynamic, animated illustrations!

—-Story Introduction—-

You’ve inherited your family’s mysterious “Elegant Pheromones”, which give any women who breathe them in the insatiable desire to mate with you! Frankly, you’ve had enough of this curse, and have made it your mission to resist their advances and remain a permanent virgin... but do you really have what it takes to fend them off and stay single?

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c0032e0b7b8d95a4b1a274b9cb30a63ba26ed745.jpg

—-Game Mechanics—-

 Time-limited Escapes: Get away from your female pursuers before time runs out so you can save yourself for true love! Be careful, because if you’re caught even once, there's no getting that chastity back!
 Collectibles: Girls just get in the way of gaming time, amiright!? Collect all the consoles you can find so you can stay a virgin gamer... forever!
Unlockable Scenes: Use the coins you get from completing levels to unlock special story content.


https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/e85efa40d5f270a36950c632ba50d21f445ebea4.png

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/ad22b1c8645232df2863e27e89826a4f658328bf.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2812180/_/

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/74cbf2995d4086512b29da70df0515ff8158b711.gif

This is a light puzzle game where you play as Onmyoji characters "Yang" and "Yue" to exorcise spirits from a mansion. Enjoy immersive, eerie puzzles without any fear!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949720/_/?beta=1

A young girl finds herself trapped in the lair of tentacles. The player must escape from this nest. However, these creatures seem to have only one thing on their minds"lust"! As long as you drain all the monsters you encounter, you can escape, right?

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/ea9c0b2cb1f0d4e2ab4b887d1192f2be21df1730.jpg
